issue: After Kisor v. Wilkie, must a federal court exhaust traditional tools of statutory interpretation before deferring to Sentencing Guidelines commentary under Stinson v. United States, or does Stinson deference survive Kisor?
provision: U.S.S.G. § 2B1.1 cmt. n.3; Stinson v. United States, 508 U.S. 36 (1993); Kisor v. Wilkie, 139 S. Ct. 2400 (2019)

sides.position: Kisor overruled Stinson, so courts must exhaust the traditional tools of statutory interpretation before deferring to Guidelines commentary.
Stinson deference to Guidelines commentary survives Kisor, so courts defer to commentary that interprets an ambiguous guideline unless it is plainly erroneous or inconsistent with the guideline.

quote: He asks us to conclude that Kisor overruled the Supreme Court's earlier decision in Stinson, 508 U.S. at 45, an issue presently subject to a circuit split.
cite: United States v. Junaid Gulzar, 92 F.4th 684 (7th Cir. 2024)
